releaseNotes:
Home Remote 1.4.1 improves the playback controls across all five Android themes.

- Rewind and Fast-forward use the existing native LG commands. The foreground TV app determines their behaviour; no fixed jump duration is promised.
- One central Play/Pause uses fresh playback state. Separate Play and Pause remain available when state is unknown or stale.
- Remove numbered skips and hide unverified Restart/Next actions. Improve large-text layout without shrinking touch targets.
- Preserve the existing package, signing identity, profiles and pairing storage for an in-place update.

Physical Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video playback observations remain pending. Programme-title support remains under investigation. This update adds no YouTube internet integration.
